nature_language: 当前位置苏州。我两个人想去杭州玩2天，预算4000人民币，住一间大床房，期间打车，酒店最好有窗外好景，想去雷峰塔看一下，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Suzhou. Two of us want to visit Hangzhou for 2 days with a budget of 4000 RMB. We would like to stay in a hotel with a large bed and preferably a nice view from the window. We plan to take taxis during our stay and would like to visit Leifeng Pagoda. Please provide a travel plan.
